title: CommunityPulseReadResult
description: community.pulse-read-result@1: answers of community.pulse.read on OpenVibe.Community (anyone). GET /api/v1/pulse?origin=user|ai|system&after=&limit= → { items, next_cursor } (newest first, at most 100; an unknown origin or a cursor this API did not issue is 400). GET /pulse is the same activity as an HTML page.
